corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 2nd-order stroke on the right leg (ይሁን), which is the standard Amharic jussive before ዘንድ ('ይሁን ዘንድ').
Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 6:5 plural locative 'በምኵራባት' (in the synagogues), visually confirmed in the zoomed image.
The printed word is 'ጩኻችሁ' (crying out / shouting, matching the immediately following citation 'ኢትከላህ' and line 29 'ጩኻችሁ አትጸልዩ'), misread as 'ጨርሣችሁ' due to ink bleed on ጩኻ.
